tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags ni spyi lo 1572lor yab drung 'tsho phun tshogs dang*/ yum phan thogs skyid gnyis kyi sras su gtsang sems cher zhes pa'i yul du 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das shing*/ yi ge 'bri klog sogs kyang tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig par kun mkhyen ngag dbang grags pas rjes su bzung ste chos 'khor lhun por lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ de rjes thub bstan yangs pa can gyi chos grwa chen por byon nas/ dge bshes dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ngag dbang chos grags zhes gsol/ de nas bzung mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang dang*/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel/ jo nang ta ra na tha/ mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs shing*/ phar tshad/ dbu sdom/ 'dul mdzod de pod chen drug gi mtshon gzhung lugs mtha' dag la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad cing*/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par rig pas 'byams klas/ sa skya dang*/ ngam ring sogs su grwa bskor mdzad pas rig pa rlabs che zhing rtsod pa shag rno bas mkhas grags kyis mtshan snyan 'bar/ dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes shing thos don ji bzhin sgom pas nyams su blangs pas lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs/ dgung lo sum cu par rje 'bum phrag lnga pa'i gdan khrir 'khod de blo gsal tshogs la legs bshad kyi skyes bstsal/ dgong lo so lnga par thub bstan yangs pa can gyi chos grwa chen po'i khri la 'khod cing*/ lo drug gi bar du blo gsal 'dus pa'i tshogs la sde snod kyi 'chad nyan rgyun mi chad pa mdzad/ gzhan yang bsam 'grub dgon dang mnyam yod bya gshong dang*/ grwa tshang chen mo/ chos 'khor lhun po sogs nas gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang*/

dka' bcu ba mang po'i dbus lan grangs du mar mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par 'bel gtam dang dogs dpyod mdzad pas kun rje 'di'i mkhyen rab la ngo mtshar/ de nas bzung paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags zhes pa'i mkhas snyan yang phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna rgyan du byas/ bar skabs rnams su bla brang rdzong dang*/ 'dar chos 'khor/ bzang ldan chos sde sogs la phebs te 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bur gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi mtshon gang la gang 'dul gyis chos bka' mtha' yas pa dang*/ rab byung snyan rdzogs mdzad pa'ang brgya phrag las rgal ba sogs bstan 'gro'i don chen rlabs po che sgrub/ rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyang rjes 'brang gi blo gsal rnams la skyes su bstsal ba'i bstan bcos ji snyed cig mdzad pa yang tshad ma rigs gter gyi rnam bshad/ phar phyin spyi don/ dbu 'jug mtha' dpyod/sdom gsum rab dbye'i ṭīk+ka/ 'dul ba'i spyi don chen mo/ mdzod kyi spyi don/ mkhas 'jug rnam bshad/ pod chen drug gi 'bel gtam gtsos pod chen bcu phrag lhag bzhugs shing*/ de dag kyang sdeb sbyor gyi sgros gtsang ba'i blo gzu bo gnas pa sus bltas kyang yid smon kho na bya ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i legs bshad 'ba' zhig go / gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma yang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ de'i gcung thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dbon rin po che bdag chen byams pa bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan po mkhas mchog rnam rgyal sogs thub bstan gyi gdugs dkar dgung du 'degs pa'i slob tshogs nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam bskrun pa'i gtsos 'khor lo gsum gyis rgyal bstan yun ring du bskyangs mthar spyi lo 1641lo dgung grangs bdun cu par zhi bar gshegs so//
